agyos_skill.intent: Competitor Scout. Finds the weak points of your competitors in their own App Store reviews: searches the App Store for the apps people already use for your idea, reads up to the 500 most recent reviews of each, sorts the one- and two-star ones into themes (fees and pricing, cancellations and no-shows, support, bugs, trust and safety, payments and refunds, availability), and names each rival's weak point with the evidence (\
